text.feels_intro: How {name}'s scorch marks feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: a hot red flush where the flame was played across {his} cheek or brow, the skin tight and glossy; the tips of {his} eyebrows are curled and singed. A faint smell of burnt hair hangs about {him}.

{name}'s face: taut, shining blisters swell along the cheek and jaw, some already broken and weeping clear fluid; the eyebrow on that side is gone, the hairline frizzled to brittle stubble. {name} smells of scorched hair and cooked skin.

{name}'s face: the slow flame has done its worst; patches of skin are blackened and leathery, split at the edges into raw, weeping red; the eyelid is swollen shut and the hair above it is burnt away. The sickly-sweet stench of seared flesh clings to {him}.
{name}'s face: the burns are drying, the dead skin peeling in pale curls from the edges; dark crusted scabs sit where the blisters were, the skin around them tight and reddened.
{name}'s face: smooth, shiny pink new skin covers the burns, thin and glossy, edged with darker blotches; the eyebrow is growing back in sparse, short hairs.
{name}'s face: only a faint, slightly glossy discoloration remains on {his} cheek or brow, a shade paler than the skin around it.
body: {name}'s back: blotches of angry red skin across {his} shoulder blades where the flame was trailed slowly over {him}, hot to the touch; the fine hairs there are singed away. A faint scorched smell rises from {his} skin.

{name}'s back: rows of fat, glistening blisters cluster where the flame lingered, several burst and weeping, the skin between them a deep, swollen red. The smell of singed hair and scalded skin clings to {him}.

{name}'s back: broad patches seared black and leathery, cracked open into raw, weeping flesh; blisters the size of a palm sag and drip, and nothing can be laid against it. The cloying stench of burnt flesh hangs around {him}.
{name}'s back: the burns have dried into tight, dark crusts; sheets of dead skin peel away at the edges, showing raw pink beneath.
{name}'s back: shiny, stretched pink new skin covers the burned patches, thin and hairless, framed by blotchy darker skin.
{name}'s back: faint, glossy discolored patches remain across {his} shoulder blades, slightly smoother than the skin around them.
arm: {name}'s {part}: a reddened streak of skin along the forearm or upper arm, tight and hot, the fine hairs singed into tiny curls. A faint smell of burnt hair rises from it.
{name}'s {part}: swollen red skin raised in taut, watery blisters, a few broken and weeping, the hair burnt away entirely. It smells of singed skin.
{name}'s {part}: the skin is blackened and stiff in patches, split into raw, weeping cracks; the hand below is puffy and swollen. It reeks of seared flesh.
{name}'s {part}: dark, dry crusts over the burns, the dead skin peeling in pale flakes; the arm is held a little bent.
{name}'s {part}: shiny, smooth pink new skin over the burned stretch, thin and tender-looking, the hair not yet grown back.
{name}'s {part}: a faint, slightly glossy patch of discolored skin remains along the arm.
leg: {name}'s {part}: a hot red patch across the thigh or calf where the flame was held, the skin tight and the hair singed short. A faint smell of burnt hair rises from it.
{name}'s {part}: blisters bubble up across the reddened skin, swollen and glistening, some broken and weeping down the leg. It smells of scorched skin and hair.
{name}'s {part}: patches burnt black and leathery, cracked through to raw, oozing flesh; the leg is swollen and angry red around them. The stench of seared flesh rises from it.
{name}'s {part}: the burns have crusted dark and dry, dead skin peeling away in strips, the swelling going down.
{name}'s {part}: smooth, shiny pink new skin over the burns, thin and hairless, ringed with darker blotches.
{name}'s {part}: a faint, glossy discoloration remains across the thigh or calf.

head: {name}'s face stings with a hot, tight burn, as if {he} had stood too long at a forge, and every flush of blood makes it prickle. {name} is shaken and indignant, squinting, and keeps turning {his} face away from any warmth.

{name}'s face burns with a deep, pulsing heat, and the blisters throb and pull whenever {he} moves {his} mouth. {name} is frightened and furious at once, speaking stiffly through a barely open mouth and flinching from every candle and torch.

{name}'s face is searing, relentless agony that does not fade even when the flame is gone, and {he} is shivering and sick with it. {name} is in shock or close to panic, half blind on that side, words coming slurred and broken, and the sight of any flame makes {him} recoil.
{name}'s face itches maddeningly as the dead skin peels, and the scabs crack when {he} smiles or frowns. {name} is self-conscious and tired, moving {his} face as little as {he} can.
{name}'s face is tight and tender where the new skin is, prickling in the cold and stinging under sweat. {name} shies away from the heat of a fire and from hands reaching toward {his} face.
{name}'s face feels normal again apart from a faint tightness in the cold. The warmth of a hearth on that cheek brings back a quiet memory of the flame, and {he} flinches a little near open fire.
body: {name}'s back burns like a sunburn under a hot hand, and the brush of clothing makes it flare. {name} is jumpy and hyper-aware of {his} skin, holding {his} shoulders stiff and away from anything that might touch {him}.

{name}'s back is a pulsing, scalding ache, and the blisters pull and tear whenever {he} twists or breathes deep. {name} is resentful and enduring it through gritted teeth, holding a rigid, forward-leaning posture and unable to lean back.

{name}'s back is blazing agony that keeps burning long after the flame is gone, and {he} shakes with cold and nausea from the shock. {name} is helpless and horrified, close to collapse, gasping in shallow breaths and unable to bear the lightest touch.

{name}'s back itches deep under the peeling skin where {he} cannot scratch, and it pulls tight when {he} reaches or bends. {name} is weary and on guard, unable to lie on {his} back, moving slowly and carefully.
{name}'s back feels tight and thin-skinned where the new skin is, stinging under sweat or a rough shirt. {name} is wary of anyone behind {him} and keeps clear of hot hearths.
{name}'s back has its full movement again; only a faint tightness lingers. The heat of a fire at {his} back makes {him} tense and flinch, a quiet memory of the flame.
arm: {name}'s {part} stings with a hot, prickling burn, like skin held too close to a candle. {name} holds it away from {his} body and sleeves, wary of moving it.
{name}'s {part} burns with a throbbing heat, and the blisters ache and pull when {he} bends the elbow or grips. {name} is irritable and guarding, cradling the arm and unable to hold anything firmly.

{name}'s {part} is searing agony that pulses down into the fingers, the burn still raging long after the flame. {name} is in despair or desperate rage; the arm is useless and {he} cannot bear anything to touch it.
{name}'s {part} is stiff and itches as the skin peels, and straightening it cracks the crusts. {name} is frustrated at being limited and cannot reach far or carry much.
{name}'s {part} is tender and tight where the new skin is, stinging when bumped or warmed. {name} keeps it back from cooking fires and hot iron.
{name}'s {part} has its full feeling and strength again. Reaching toward a fire brings a small flinch and a quiet memory of the flame.
leg: {name}'s {part} stings hot on the surface, prickling under cloth. {name} is annoyed and shaken, walking with a slight, careful hitch so nothing rubs it.
{name}'s {part} throbs with scalding heat, and the blisters pull with every step. {name} feels frustrated and vulnerable, walking stiff-legged and wincing as cloth drags across it.

{name}'s {part} is blazing agony with every step, the burn throbbing as if the flame were still on it. {name} is panicked, exhausted and shaking; {he} cannot put weight on the leg and needs support to move.
{name}'s {part} is tight and itching as the dead skin peels, cracking when {he} bends the knee. {name} is weary of the slow mending and limps, resting the leg whenever {he} can.
{name}'s {part} is tender and tight where the new skin is, stinging in the cold or under rough cloth. {name} walks almost normally but keeps the leg back from the fire.
{name}'s {part} has its full strength and movement again; the old burn tightens faintly in the cold. Sitting near a fire brings a small flinch, a quiet memory of the flame.

levels: , the small flame passed slowly over bare skin. The heat builds from a warm prickle to a sharp, biting sting, and {he} jerks and hisses as the skin reddens and the fine hairs curl. A smell of singed hair rises.

over skin that is already reddened and tight. The heat sinks into the tender burn and it flares into a scalding throb; {he} cries out as fresh blisters rise and {his} breath comes ragged. The smell of scorched hair and skin thickens.

, and the flame settles on blistered, weeping skin. Blisters swell and burst under the heat, and the pain becomes a sickening, unrelenting blaze that tears a scream from {him} and leaves {him} shaking. The smell of seared skin hangs in the air.

, and it is too much. The flame lingers on raw, seared flesh until the skin blackens and cracks; {he} howls and then goes grey and slack, cold sweat breaking out as shock takes {him} and {his} body stops obeying {him}. The stench of burnt flesh fills the air.

stage.medium: The weeping burns on {name}'s {part} have dried into tight, blistered red skin.
stage.light: The blisters on {name}'s {part} have gone down, leaving sore, reddened skin.
stage.recovering: The burns on {name}'s {part} have crusted over and begun to peel.
stage.mostly_healed: The crusts and dead skin on {name}'s {part} have peeled away, leaving shiny pink new skin.
stage.healed: The new skin on {name}'s {part} has settled into a faint discoloration; that burn has fully healed.

heal.source_healed: All of {name}'s scorch marks have healed.
heal.passive: {text} This is only {his} body's ordinary healing; the people of Skyrim mend quickly, and nobody would think it worth remarking on.

start.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}, beginning to soothe {own} burns, blisters, and pain.
start.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light, beginning to soothe {own} burns, blisters, and pain.

pain_gone.none: The sting of {name}'s burns is gone, but the healing continues.
pain_gone.source: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} has drawn the heat and pain from {own} burns, but the healing continues.

full.none: {name}'s scorch marks are now fully healed, leaving {him} without pain or blemish.
full.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. {name}'s scorch marks are now fully healed, leaving {him} without pain or blemish.
full.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. {name}'s scorch marks are now fully healed, leaving {him} without pain or blemish.

heal_events.stopped: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} fades before the healing is done; {own} burns are {progress}.
